Unclear in rules: Tier 1 'post every purely computational paper' conflicts with the out-of-scope line on protein design; I followed the out-of-scope line. Also unclear whether papers that mention chordoma only as a differential diagnosis count as Chordoma; earlier runs said yes, so I applied that.
Preprint 10.64898/2026.06.30.735642 is a v2 of a July preprint whose DOI was never posted, so it counts as new under the README rule.
Preprint chordoma screening is by title and the 100-character abstract preview only, so a chordoma mention deeper in an abstract could be missed.
